zh.summary: 跟进官方 DSH 0.1.7-alpha.1，统一插件管理与会话操作，完善升级恢复和存储维护。
highlights: 插件市场沿用官方添加插件流程，安装、更新完成后提供明确的重启或刷新按钮。
内置正式版会话管理 1.5.0 和图片查看器 0.1.2，适配新版官方界面与插件图标。
会话管理保留官方侧边栏功能，补充归档入口、会话内容搜索和永久删除；图片标注可返回原输入草稿。
改善插件依赖存储、缓存与备份的维护边界，保留会话、设置、附件和工作区。
兼容官方旧设置迁移，保留完整语音运行库，并补充 macOS 麦克风权限用途说明。
knownIssues: Portable 为正式发行版，内置官方 DSH 仍为 0.1.7-alpha.1；第三方插件需分别确认兼容性。
程序回滚不等于会话数据格式降级；升级前请保留独立备份。
完整离线包不包含模型；已有第三方插件依赖缺少离线缓存时，其更新仍可能需要联网。
upgradeNotes: 退出 Portable 后再升级；保留原 data 和 workspace。
默认插件的用户禁用状态会保留，更新不会擅自重新启用。

en.summary: Follow official DSH 0.1.7-alpha.1 with unified plugin management, updated session tools, and improved recovery and storage maintenance.
highlights: Use the official Add plugin flow and offer explicit restart or reload actions after installation and updates.
Bundle stable Session Manager 1.5.0 and Image Viewer 0.1.2 with updated official UI integration and plugin icons.
Preserve official sidebar actions while adding archive navigation, content search and permanent deletion. Return image annotations to the original draft.
Improve dependency-store, cache and backup maintenance while preserving sessions, settings, attachments and workspaces.
Support official legacy-settings migration, retain the speech runtime, and declare microphone usage on macOS.
knownIssues: Portable is a stable release; its bundled official DSH remains 0.1.7-alpha.1. Third-party plugins require separate compatibility checks.
Application rollback does not downgrade session data formats. Keep an independent backup before upgrading.
Complete offline packages do not include models. Updating existing third-party plugins may require a connection when dependencies are absent from the offline cache.
upgradeNotes: Exit Portable before upgrading and retain data and workspace.
User-disabled default plugins remain disabled after updates.
